video_title: Carmelo Anthony and Jeremy Lin Finally Break Silence on 'Linsanity', the Knicks Exit & Their Issues

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on his public silence regarding his Knicks exit
quotes.excerpt: I've actually never spoken publicly about my exit from New York until today.
quotes.quote: I've actually never spoken publicly about my exit from New York until today.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on his rookie year struggles with imposter syndrome
quotes.excerpt: My rookie year, I had a horrible year because I had imposter syndrome.
quotes.quote: My rookie year, I had a horrible year because I had imposter syndrome. I didn't come from a background where anybody ever said you could make the NBA. It was never a reality. It was like, you're crazy. You think you can make the NBA?

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on his breakthrough with the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: My second year with the Knicks, that's when I was like, I'm having almost 30 point triple-doubles.
quotes.quote: My second year with the Knicks, that's when I was like, I'm having almost 30 point triple-doubles in the D-League. Every time I get in during garbage time, I'm making something happen. I truly believe I'm going to contribute.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on the difficulty of meshing his style with Carmelo Anthony
quotes.excerpt: I am a pick-and-roll player, ball-heavy, ball-dominant, and you are maybe the best mid-post isolation scorer.
quotes.quote: I am a pick-and-roll player, ball-heavy, ball-dominant, and you are maybe the best mid-post isolation scorer. These two styles are realistically not something that is going to naturally mesh. So you got to work on meshing at it.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the rapid pace of events during Linsanity
quotes.excerpt: I got hurt, and then he comes in and play. We're on the back-to-back-to-back.
quotes.quote: I got hurt, and then he comes in and play. We're on the back-to-back-to-back. Shit is happening so fast. Nobody knows what's next. I don't know what to do next. I don't know who to go to next.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on his desire for Jeremy Lin to succeed
quotes.excerpt: Forget being jealous of what he's doing, I want him to keep going.
quotes.quote: Forget being jealous of what he's doing, I want him to keep going. Game winning in DC, keep going. Toronto, keep going.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on his playful warnings to Jeremy Lin
quotes.excerpt: I'm laughing and joking with him about, yo, you coming in this, you going to get your ass bust.
quotes.quote: I'm laughing and joking with him about, yo, you coming in this, you going to get your ass bust. You going to listen, you. He like, well about who? Who the fuck is Jeremy Lin? Like who the fuck is Jeremy Lin? He said that in the media.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on the financial impact of his Knicks exit
quotes.excerpt: I drove in $100 million in revenue. I got paid $400,000 and then I got dropped.
quotes.quote: I drove in $100 million in revenue. I got paid $400,000 and then I got dropped. And I never got an offer in free agency. And I'm like, my exit from the New York Knicks crushed me.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on the lack of team alignment during his Knicks tenure
quotes.excerpt: I don't think our coaching staff was aligned either.
quotes.quote: I don't think our coaching staff was aligned either. There's a lot going on and all of a sudden, you know, I wouldn't even say our coaching staff was aligned either.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on Carmelo Anthony's support during his Knicks tenure
quotes.excerpt: I do believe Carmelo Anthony wanted me there on the team because during my workout, I crushed my Knicks workout.
quotes.quote: I do believe Carmelo Anthony wanted me there on the team because during my workout, I crushed my Knicks workout. I crushed it. And Carmelo Anthony called me into his office and was like, look man, we got these picks. Basically what he was trying to say was, I really like you and I'm going to try to convince them to, but I can't guarantee it.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on overcoming early career trauma and finding closure
quotes.excerpt: I went to therapy around this. I had a sports psychologist around this because there was trauma.
quotes.quote: I went to therapy around this. I had a sports psychologist around this because there was trauma from early in my career that I wasn't able to get past to get to that next level as a player and I needed professional help. How do I trust people? How do I not feel like the other shoe is going to drop? I was always, when things were going well, I was kind of like, yeah, but something bad is going to happen. That was always what I was dealing with.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: The Kid Mero on the viral video of a Knicks fan breakdancing
quotes.excerpt: I seen Hasidic Jews breakdancing with black kids. This is the greatest unification of the city.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: I seen Hasidic Jews breakdancing with black kids. This is the greatest unification of the city since 9/11. And everybody thought he was lying. And then this link dropped.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaq's comments on Cardi B during the Knicks halftime show
quotes.excerpt: Shaq is glued to Cardi B. Chill, focus Shaq.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: Shaq is glued to Cardi B. Chill, focus Shaq.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeremy Lin
text_blocks.text: Come on, Shaq. You wild, Shaq.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on teaching young players his signature basketball moves
quotes.excerpt: There's two things that I literally teach these young players. I'm like, watch Melo.
quotes.quote: On the basketball side, even when I talk to young players now, I do say, there's two things that you did, and you did many amazing things on the court, but there's two things where I literally teach these young players, I'm like, watch Melo. You are actually somebody that I'm like, the next generation, y'all got to watch, y'all got to pick up these two moves.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin breaks down his signature hesitation and spin moves
quotes.excerpt: You got your right foot in the air and then you plant it so fast.
quotes.quote: It's the one where you catch it and then you pretend like you're going to drive, and then you just, you take, you got your right foot in the air and then you plant it so fast, like you're thinking you're about to drive, but then you just bam, right up. And then the ball is up and out while you're on the way up, and the defender is literally trying to process it and you're already shooting a smooth jumper. And the other one is that spin move where you take almost like a fake dribble left, but you're really right into his chest, and then quick spin.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the importance of open communication and reconciliation
quotes.excerpt: Regardless what you thought we was going through, what I thought we was going through.
quotes.quote: Regardless what you thought we was going through, what I thought we was going through, if it took 14 years to sit on this couch and hash that out and talk, or if it took me taking some time out to just spend two hours with you on the phone and really answering the questions that you had, these was questions that was built up for 14 years that other people probably was adding on to your pressures and your mindset and your perspective. It took me to go through what I went through to have the time to come back and be at peace with being able to answer all your questions with actual facts.
